modules.name: Android Phone (Virtual)
modules.description: A virtual Android phone, right beside you in VR.
modules.author: josethevrtech
modules.license: MIT (source); external assets retain their licenses
modules.tagline: A little Android. A lot of possibility.
modules.about: Android Phone (Virtual) keeps everyday apps within reach: notes, calendar, clock, calculator, files, gallery, music, podcasts, radio, video and a web browser. Its own Apps & media page opens streaming services, app stores and Google web apps. First setup downloads about 214 MB. Some apps require sign-in; Google Play Services and DRM are not provided, and service compatibility varies. Pick up the phone or return it to the shelf. Off stops Android and its audio; installed apps and data remain for next time.

modules.license: MIT (source); external assets retain their licenses

modules.about: Smartphone Digivice brings Digital Partner into VR inside Jojogape’s Courage smartphone model. Pick it up, care for your pet, and place it anywhere in your space. The on-device settings control size, brightness and placement; name fields open the headset keyboard. Off stops the game and its audio. Saved pets and settings stay in the same private data directory across updates.

modules.name: Pocket Pikachu
modules.description: A nostalgic Pocket Pikachu with headset steps, original-style settings, a daily alarm and native controller play.
modules.author: josethevrtech
modules.license: MIT (integration); third-party assets retain their rights
modules.about:
MEET PIKACHU
Walk and spend time with Pikachu, earn watts, and give gifts to grow your friendship. He follows his own daily routines and sleeps at night.

FIRST START
Press A to open the Poke Ball. Set the clock: Left/Right selects hour or minute, Up/Down changes it, and A saves.

FRAME CONTROLS
A: confirm. B: back/cancel. X: friendship. Y: settings. You can also point at the handheld buttons and click them.

FIND A MENU
While Pikachu is on screen, Left/Right selects the top icons: Clock, Gift, or Slots. Press A to open the selected icon. B returns to Pikachu; finish an active slot round before leaving.

EARN & GIVE WATTS
Keep the creation On and move with your headset worn. Estimated walking steps earn 1 watt per 20 steps. Open Gift, use Up/Down to change a digit, and press A to advance through the digits to GIVE. Press A on GIVE to spend that amount. B goes back. Giving 0 watts can upset Pikachu!

PLAY SLOTS
You need 5 watts per round. Open Slots and press A to start, then press A to stop each reel in turn. Matching symbols can win watts; gambling can also lose them.

SETTINGS & ALARM
Y opens RESET, SOUND and TIME SET. Up/Down selects; A confirms. RESET here clears only the visible step counter. The tiny recessed reset button clears the entire pet, so avoid it unless starting over.
On Clock, A toggles the alarm. With it On, press Down then A to edit: Left/Right selects hour/minute, Up/Down changes it, A saves, B cancels. Any handheld button dismisses a ringing alarm.

PICK UP & PLACE
Grip the housing to hold it; release to place. Center sticks after pickup. The holding stick pushes/pulls directly. Hold in your right hand to navigate with the left stick or D-pad. When held in your left hand, use its D-pad to play. Shake deliberately to return to the dock; Menu/View also returns home.

Progress saves automatically. Turning Off pauses steps and alarms.

screenshots.caption: Pocket Pikachu’s live pixel display inside Wikiti’s yellow handheld model.

modules.name: Sonic Tiger LCD
modules.description: Play Sonic the Hedgehog from Internet Archive inside a 3D Tiger handheld on Steam Frame. Internet required. No ROM import.
modules.author: josethevrtech
modules.about:
SONIC ON YOUR SHELF
Play the original Sonic the Hedgehog LCD game through Internet Archive's online player. Pick up the handheld, place it nearby, or return it to your MagicShelf.

START PLAYING
An internet connection is needed to load the player. Wait for the game screen, then press X or point at ON/START and pull the trigger. No ROM import is needed.

CONTROLS
Directions: move and jump. A: Spin. B: Pause. X: ON/START. Y: Settings. Point at the model buttons with your free hand and hold the trigger to hold a key. The two ATTACK halves activate Spin; ACTION jumps. ACL resets the game.

PICK UP AND PLACE
Hold grip to pick up; release to place. The holding stick adjusts distance. Home or a deliberate shake returns it to the shelf.

SOUND AND CONNECTION
Y opens sound, volume and Reload Online Player. The handheld plays its own sound cues, not a continuous soundtrack. If loading fails, use Retry. Archive.org availability and loading times can vary.

PLEASE KNOW
The model is Mattyew's Sonic 2 casing; the online game is Sonic 1. Settings are saved. The online game restarts when turned Off or reloaded. This is a free fan-made integration, not an official Sega, Tiger Electronics or Internet Archive product.
